description: A rare inflammatory variant of epidermal nevus with linear or whorled plaques and recurrent inflammation.
causes: Congenital or early developmental epidermal mosaicism with inflammatory features

appearance.general: Unilateral or linear verrucous plaques arranged along developmental skin lines, often with erythema and scale.

warning_signs: Rapid change, bleeding, ulceration, or persistent pain warrants medical assessment.
doctor_discussion_points: Discuss age at onset, distribution, chronicity, and whether biopsy is required for confirmation.
